title: #smallpoems I slip below depth of possibilities and drown in broken realities stolen crowns in vocal fealty to token histories woven in unspoken ties
summary: #smallpoems I slip below depth of possibilities and drown in broken realities stolen crowns in vocal fealty to token histories woven in unspoken ties beneath me. Concrete feet who seek to sunk a broken lung painted in lead of lost hope
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems

I slip below depth
  of possibilities
and drown in
     broken realities

stolen crowns
  in vocal
fealty
   to token
histories
woven
  in unspoken
ties beneath
me. Concrete
feet who seek
   to sunk
a broken lung
painted
in
lead of
  lost hope
